4wm9: Today, while business leaders are looking for tremendous amounts of information, they also need trained employees who know how to source, clean, analyze and visualize data to maximize its value. The Bachelor of Arts in Business Analytics provides the foundation needed to transform a maze of numbers into well-informed data driven decisions. In addition to providing students with fundamental big data resource and infrastructure management skills, this program is designed to provide students with exposure to applied areas (specifically: Information Systems, Accounting, Finance, Marketing and Supply Chain Management) through specific degree requirements. This program cultivates organizational and technical competencies to implement data gathering, cleansing, integrating and modeling tasks, as well as data asset analysis for business applications. The Bachelor of Arts in Business Analytics also covers data warehousing, dimensional modeling, big data analytics methods, and visualization tools and techniques, and it introduces topics such as data mining and predictive analytics. Employment opportunity for Business Analytics majors are diverse and students can work in areas such as healthcare, finance, information technology, telecommunications, consulting, data analytics, marketing, manufacturing, human resources, government, and many more.
4wms: Information security refers to everything one must do to protect information assets from danger. Such dangers can include but are nor limited to unauthorized access, use, disclosure, disruption, modification, destruction or theft of data or information. It could be one's own personal or an organization’s information assets. And it could also be internally within an organization or in cyberspace on the Internet. This nationally recognized information security concentration provides students the knowledge and technical skills needed to secure, monitor, protect and defend attacks to an individual or organization’s information assets i.e., databases, software, networks, and information systems.
4wmt: Today’s businesses run on technology, and businesses need technology analysts to help them succeed. This Bachelor of Arts in Information System and Technology provides students with a comprehensive set of skills needed to capture, structure, manage, and recommends actionable insights throughout an organization. Students will learn how to apply Information and Technology concepts to support and improve the internal systems in an organization and gain insight on implementing effective information systems analysis and design. Students graduating from this program will find diverse career opportunity to become Information Technology Managers, Information Security Specialists, Information and Technology Project Managers, Network Support Specialists, Systems Administrators, System Integrators, and Database Administrators.

The Master of Science in Computer Science degree program provides a technically oriented post baccalaureate scientific education for those who wish to acquire or extend their knowledge in the field of computer science. The program combines both the study of modern computer devices and their applications along with the study of the philosophical foundations which underlie the discipline.

In addition to the above goals and objectives, the program is also committed to improving the writing and communication skills of the student.

The Master of Business Administration (MBA) program provides post-baccalaureate students with a high-quality masters-level education in the field of business administration. The program is designed to prepare promising students for positions of increasing responsibility and leadership through education in the broad scope of business. It is open to all qualified students regardless of undergraduate major.

Master of Business Administration - Traditional Concentrations (36 or 42 units): For qualified applicants seeking to develop in-depth, graduate-level knowledge in one or more specialized business areas.
